name: stress associated endoplasmic reticulum protein family member 2

function.text: SERP2 encodes stress-associated endoplasmic reticulum protein 2. It participates in endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: SERP2 encodes stress-associated endoplasmic reticulum protein 2. Based in part on similarity, it interacts with target proteins during their translocation into the lumen of the endoplasmic reticulum. It protects unfolded target proteins against degradation during ER stress. It may facilitate glycosylation of target proteins after termination of ER stress.
